meta.name: li-carousel
meta.description: Build a LinkedIn document post (carousel) - slide-by-slide copy, the cover that earns the swipe, and the PDF to upload. Use when the user says "carousel", "document post", "slides for LinkedIn", "turn this into a carousel", or has a list-shaped idea that would die as a text post.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把清单式想法做成领英轮播图文,配好逐页文案与吸睛封面,直接导出可上传的 PDF。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在领英上做内容,想把一段干货清单变成能滑动的图文帖。
copy.tagline_en: Turn list ideas into a LinkedIn carousel: slide copy, cover, upload-ready PDF.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on LinkedIn and want to turn a list into a swipeable carousel.

howto.what: 你把一个有顺序的想法交给它，Claude 会写出 8-12 页幻灯片文案（含封面、每页一个要点、回顾页和单一 CTA），再做成 1080x1350 的 PDF 供你自己发到 LinkedIn。
howto.when: 当你提到“carousel”“document post”等词，或你的想法是步骤、倒计时、前后对比这类有顺序的内容时会触发；单一观点的想法会被转给 /li-post。

say.text: 把这个想法做成 LinkedIn carousel
say.note: 先给逐页文案，你确认后再生成 PDF

say.text: 帮我写 carousel 的封面和 8 页幻灯片
say.note: 封面控制在 6 个词以内

say.text: 把这份清单转成 carousel，并写好配文

howto.what_en: Give it a step-by-step idea and Claude writes 8-12 slide copy (cover, one idea per slide, recap, single CTA), then builds a 1080x1350 PDF that you upload to LinkedIn yourself.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "carousel", "document post" or similar, or when the idea has a sequence - steps, a countdown, a before/after. Single-claim ideas get sent to /li-post.

say_en.text: Turn this idea into a LinkedIn carousel
say_en.note: Drafts slide copy first, builds the PDF after you approve

say_en.text: Write the cover and 8 slides for a carousel
say_en.note: Cover stays at six words or fewer

say_en.text: Turn this list into a carousel with post text
